title: Kenzs Lost Her Glow sticks

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Hey! Hey—you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! Hey—you!

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: You haven't seen a pack of glow sticks have you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You haven't seen a pack of glow sticks have you?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Yeah... You know: little plastic tubes that you crack and shake and they glow bright colors. Hence the name: glow sticks. Like the ones I'm wearing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah... You know: little plastic tubes that you crack and shake and they glow bright colors. Hence the name: glow sticks. Like the ones I'm wearing?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: I bet you took 'em. Yeah. I'll throw Lims on the fact that you stole 'em to try and get into the show at DXncYrs. No way you're getting in dressed like... that. So, you figure fuck it, let's get me some accessories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I bet you took 'em. Yeah. I'll throw Lims on the fact that you stole 'em to try and get into the show at DXncYrs. No way you're getting in dressed like... that. So, you figure fuck it, let's get me some accessories.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: I am not on anything. I'm also not not on anything. It's a double not. Not like the double knot I'm gonna leave your trachea in if you took my glow sticks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am not on anything. I'm also not not on anything. It's a double not. Not like the double knot I'm gonna leave your trachea in if you took my glow sticks.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Whatever. It's fine. I definitely lost 'em though. Will have to scour for another pack before I hit the party. This LUZ man. So hard to get contraband shit you know? Friggin' CorpSec.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever. It's fine. I definitely lost 'em though. Will have to scour for another pack before I hit the party. This LUZ man. So hard to get contraband shit you know? Friggin' CorpSec.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Nothing yet. Trying to network but things haven't been as good as they used to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing yet. Trying to network but things haven't been as good as they used to.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: You would be too if your career was tanking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You would be too if your career was tanking.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Promos have run their course and I got people bad mouthin' a show I put together because two of the DJs bailed last minute. Something about a holo-short that sucked them into the nets or something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Promos have run their course and I got people bad mouthin' a show I put together because two of the DJs bailed last minute. Something about a holo-short that sucked them into the nets or something.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Blast if I know. Haven't heard from em' since.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Blast if I know. Haven't heard from em' since.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: I don't know. Reputation is everything in this circuit and those fools sent mine to the bottom of the grimy-ass sea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. Reputation is everything in this circuit and those fools sent mine to the bottom of the grimy-ass sea.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Haha. Be the least you could do if you stole my sticks. What you lookin' for in return.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha. Be the least you could do if you stole my sticks. What you lookin' for in return.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Ah, there it is! Like the bass drop boom! Alright, help me get my reputation back to where I can get into the Spire, and I'll bring you into whatever club you want.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, there it is! Like the bass drop boom! Alright, help me get my reputation back to where I can get into the Spire, and I'll bring you into whatever club you want.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Wow. Alright. There's a bonus track I didn't expect to hear.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow. Alright. There's a bonus track I didn't expect to hear.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: The biggest thing is getting something to promote. All the joints on club corner have event calendars that will literally melt your face off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The biggest thing is getting something to promote. All the joints on club corner have event calendars that will literally melt your face off.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Whoa! Hold your Hovas. These clubs are the pulse of the city. Their beats? Those songs give us life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoa! Hold your Hovas. These clubs are the pulse of the city. Their beats? Those songs give us life.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: That's the jam! What we need is a good hit. Something that vibes with a lot of people, hitting their very souls.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the jam! What we need is a good hit. Something that vibes with a lot of people, hitting their very souls.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: No offense, but I kinda figured.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No offense, but I kinda figured.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Lean into your curious nature and help me find someone. A DJ, goes by the name Finn Amano. He used to have the synthiest, trippiest, most - umph. His songs massaged the sweats from your pores.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lean into your curious nature and help me find someone. A DJ, goes by the name Finn Amano. He used to have the synthiest, trippiest, most - umph. His songs massaged the sweats from your pores.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: I don't know. Everyone thinks he ate some bad fungi and got stuck in wonderland. All I know is that he started rambling about the original AG and stopped recording tracks. He still makes 'em, but won't put any out in the waves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. Everyone thinks he ate some bad fungi and got stuck in wonderland. All I know is that he started rambling about the original AG and stopped recording tracks. He still makes 'em, but won't put any out in the waves.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: I don't know. Ever since he went off the deep end he's been skulking around staring at puddles. He's probably in the canyon somewhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. Ever since he went off the deep end he's been skulking around staring at puddles. He's probably in the canyon somewhere.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Yeah, something about the way the lights reflected or something. I don't know. I had my headphones in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, something about the way the lights reflected or something. I don't know. I had my headphones in.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Holy blown speaker! I don't know. Just get him to come see me or at least record a tune. I'll start getting the word out about him making a come back. We time this right, it'll be Spire-worthy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Holy blown speaker! I don't know. Just get him to come see me or at least record a tune. I'll start getting the word out about him making a come back. We time this right, it'll be Spire-worthy.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: You? You know Finn Amano? The DJ? How?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You? You know Finn Amano? The DJ? How?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Uh-huh. And my blood is made of black lights. If you know him, talk to him! This is how we start the promo circuit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh-huh. And my blood is made of black lights. If you know him, talk to him! This is how we start the promo circuit.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Wow... Ok. Bye!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow... Ok. Bye!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nope.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Glow sticks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Glow sticks?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh! Glow sticks! Yeah, no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh! Glow sticks! Yeah, no.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can't believe those are still a thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't believe those are still a thing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can't believe those are still a thing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can't believe those are still a thing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't take your party favors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't take your party favors.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I didn't take your party favors.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I didn't take your party favors.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait—dressed like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait—dressed like what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you on drugs?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you on drugs?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's a lot of .... not-hing. Get it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a lot of .... not-hing. Get it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's a lot of .... not-hing. Get it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's a lot of .... not-hing. Get it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You got some anger in you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got some anger in you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You got some anger in you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You got some anger in you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you celebrating?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you celebrating?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not fighting you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not fighting you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you going to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you going to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you going to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait... are they dead?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait... are they dead?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I help you bring it back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I help you bring it back?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can I help you bring it back?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can I help you bring it back?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bummer. Good luck getting it back!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bummer. Good luck getting it back!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Bummer. Good luck getting it back!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Bummer. Good luck getting it back!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nothing. Just want to help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing. Just want to help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you can get me into one of the clubs in the Spire?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you can get me into one of the clubs in the Spire?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you can get me into one of the clubs in the Spire?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you can get me into one of the clubs in the Spire?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So, what's the plan?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, what's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So let's get something to melt their bodies too!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So let's get something to melt their bodies too!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So let's get something to melt their bodies too!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So let's get something to melt their bodies too!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So let's figure out how to shut 'em down!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So let's figure out how to shut 'em down!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So let's figure out how to shut 'em down!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So let's figure out how to shut 'em down!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Killer song then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Killer song then?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't play any instruments.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't play any instruments.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gee, thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gee, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then what do you need me to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then what do you need me to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Then what do you need me to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Then what do you need me to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where can I find him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where can I find him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Used to? What happened to him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Used to? What happened to him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Used to? What happened to him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Used to? What happened to him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Puddles?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Puddles?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want me to say to him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want me to say to him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want me to say to him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want me to say to him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know Finn.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know Finn.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, I've met him. Seemed cool.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I've met him. Seemed cool.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, I've met him. Seemed cool.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, I've met him. Seemed cool.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We bonded over the vibes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We bonded over the vibes.
